title: Resolution urging Albany to add license points for drag racing
summary: This resolution calls on the New York State Legislature and governor to pass S.1768/A.2585, which would add five points to a driver's license upon conviction for illegal drag racing or speed contests. The Council cites a rise in 311 complaints about drag racing, from 392 in 2019 to nearly 3,000 in 2021, with 1,296 reported in 2023. Current law criminally penalizes such racing but does not add license points.
